scripts.generate:audio: npm run copy:kokoro-assets && npm run download:kokoro-model && tsx scripts/generate-audio.ts
scripts.generate:audio:ja-n5n4: npm run copy:kokoro-assets && npm run download:kokoro-model && tsx scripts/generate-audio.ts --lang ja --ja-levels N5,N4
scripts.generate:audio:ja-rest: npm run copy:kokoro-assets && npm run download:kokoro-model && tsx scripts/generate-audio-ja.ts --ja-levels N3,N2,N1
scripts.generate:audio:test: npm run copy:kokoro-assets && npm run download:kokoro-model && tsx scripts/generate-audio.ts --limit 2
scripts.build:app:android: tsc -b && vite build --mode android --base / && node scripts/prune-offline-dist.mjs
scripts.build:app:ios: tsc -b && vite build --mode ios --base / && node scripts/prune-offline-dist.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:app && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build:app:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build:app:ios && npx cap sync ios
